description: Pick the specialist lane for one work item. Replaces a prompt-and-parse classifier.
notes: Options are lanes that exist in the estate; keep them mutually exclusive. `other` is the escape hatch and must stay.

lane.instructions: Which lane owns `task`? Judge from the text of `task` only, not from who might prefer the work.

criteria.code: Writing or repairing code, tests, configuration or build scripts.
criteria.design: Visual, interaction, layout, motion or brand-surface work.
criteria.research: Finding, comparing or verifying information before any build.
criteria.ops: Deployment, infrastructure, secrets, CI, monitoring or incidents.
criteria.docs: Prose, documentation, changelogs or handovers with no behaviour change.
criteria.other: Insufficient evidence, or the task spans lanes with no dominant one.

blocked_by_ambiguity.instructions: Would a competent agent have to guess at least one material requirement to start `task`?

criteria.true: A required input, acceptance condition or target artifact is absent or contradictory.
criteria.false: The task names what to change and how success is judged.

risk.instructions: How much damage follows if `task` is carried out wrongly and shipped without review?
criteria: Reversible with review, one shared surface
Hard to reverse, money, credentials or public surface
